### Day 1, 18:00 (evening), at Lumi's teapot house
Today I tried to go to the flowerbed and the hedge but couldn't. I looked through the spout window and saw the flowerbed and the giants' house. I held my red button to feel brave. The mailbox was empty. I'm tired but still curious about the world outside. Maybe tomorrow I'll find a way to explore more!
